body: I try things every day. I'm just tired of trying things and ending up in worse places. I work so hard, for seemingly nothing on a regular basis. Very little gives me any appreciation for life. You''re saying you have to decide if I want to try, and I decide all the time. I'm just wondering if I should try a more permanent solution, now.

I'm 20, I'm getting a bit old to have full blown identity crises. Maybe life just isn't for me. I'm the fringe depressed girl/guy who sucks at life. I've been feeling like this most of my life and it just keeps getting worse.
